data.name: Marid's Blessing
data.description: An asavir's mount receives the blessing of the marids, making it an agile partner with a flowing pace. Anyone riding the mount does not need to attempt concentration checks normally required because of the mount's movement. The mount gains a +2 racial bonus on Reflex saves.
